lore: Before a cache rides out to the Reef, the Driftwood Carver packs it into a bit stream. Tie the chunk kinds into a raft two at a time; the deeper a kind sits, the longer its code. Tie the lightest bundles first and the raft fits the reef slot.

lines.start: Eight kinds of chunk and one reef slot. Tie them into a raft.
lines.light: Two lightest together. That's the carver's way.
lines.heavy: Heavy bundles sink deep. Their codes will run long.
lines.win: The raft fits the slot with room to spare.
lines.fail: Too many bits. The raft won't fit the slot.
